vote.question: On the Joint Resolution
vote.senate_document_text: A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration relating to "Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards; Fuel System Integrity of Hydrogen Vehicles; Compressed Hydrogen Storage System Integrity; Incorporation by Reference".

object.title: A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration relating to "Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards; Fuel System Integrity of Hydrogen Vehicles; Compressed Hydrogen Storage System Integrity; Incorporation by Reference".
object.passage_action_text: Passed Senate without amendment by Yea-Nay Vote. 51 - 46. Record Vote Number: 275. (text: CR S3051)

text_binding.selection_reason: engrossed by the Senate on the vote date (es): the measure as passed

cra.rule_title: Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards; Fuel System Integrity of Hydrogen Vehicles; Compressed Hydrogen Storage System Integrity; Incorporation by Reference
cra.consequence_ref: Congressional Review Act, 5 U.S.C. 801(b): a rule disapproved by an enacted joint resolution shall not take effect (or shall not continue in effect) and may not be reissued in substantially the same form without subsequent statutory authorization.

receipt.heading_failure: If the resolution does not pass
receipt.yea_means: A Yea vote is a vote to pass the joint resolution in the Senate.
receipt.nay_means: A Nay vote is a vote against passing the joint resolution.

vote_result.statement: The Senate passed the joint resolution.

next_step.actual: The Senate passed the joint resolution. It next goes to the House.
